job.job_title: Senior Python Backend Engineer AI-Native SaaS Platform
job.job_description:
Senior Python Backend Engineers to design, build, and scale our backend and cloud infrastructure. You'll own features end-to-end from async API design and data modeling to deployment on AWS — with architectural and leadership scope growing with your seniority.

What You'll Do

Build and own REST APIs and real-time WebSocket services in FastAPI (async-first).
Write performant async Python backed by PostgreSQL (asyncpg), SQLAlchemy 2.0 / SQLModel, and Alembic migrations.
Design schemas, optimize queries, and reason about indexing, pooling, and scale.
Architect async/background workloads with Redis and AWS SQS.
Deploy and operate on AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, EC2) with Docker; Terraform/IaC for senior folks.
Implement auth, security, and multi-tenancy (JWT, OAuth2, RBAC, session/cookie auth).
Contribute to AI-native features — vector search (pgvector + embeddings) and LLM/RAG integration.
Uphold quality via pytest, clean code (black/ruff/mypy), and code review; mentor and shape standards at the senior end.
